recipes.name: Incredibly Easy Chicken and Noodles
ingredients_raw: 1 (26 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
2 cups diced, cooked chicken breast meat

steps.text: Combine chicken broth, both condensed soups, and diced chicken in a large pot. Season with onion powder, seasoning salt, and garlic powder.
Bring to a boil over high heat and stir in noodles.
Reduce heat to low and simmer until desired consistency is reached, 20 to 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Incredibly Easy Chicken and Noodles
raw_recipe.description: My aunt's chicken and noodles soup recipe is wonderfully rich thanks to two types of canned condensed soup. It's so simple and easy to make.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make a comforting, incredibly easy bowl of chicken and noodles. Just a few ingredients like: cooked chicken, spices and frozen egg noodles are simmered for a quick 30 minutes. Serve this up with crackers and that's it, this dinner is ready to go!

review.reviewBody: This was pretty tasty. Instead of using frozen noodles, I used dried noodles with an extra can of broth. It was ok but I think next time I will either try to find the frozen or cook the noodles separately before adding them to the mix. My husband was very skeptical about trying this but was impressed.

My family requests this dish regularly and there’s always enough to freeze a few servings for later. It is delicious as is, but here are the changes I’ve made to suit us: I use homemade chicken bone broth for increased nutrition and because it’s so inexpensive and simple to make and freeze. I substitute 3 regular size cans of cream of chicken soup for the large one and I buy the frozen noodles that are already cooked to make this easy recipe come together even faster. I add 2 bags of frozen peas & carrots for added color and nutrition as well, steamed in the microwave. Today I tried making in the crockpot and it turned out beautifully. I actually put the chicken and broth in frozen on high. When the meat was 165 degrees (a couple hours) I shredded it and whisked in the cream soups and seasonings, and let it heat up for another hour or so. Then added the veggies & frozen noodles. Another hour and it was done and ready to eat. Next time I’m going to try adding a few Tbsp of butter just because it sounds good. Thanks for sharing a great recipe!
I cut the amount of chicken broth by 1/3 and added diced onion and mixed vegetables. I also cooked the noodles prior to adding them. Everyone loved it!

This was excellent. Even better the next day. Although I did change it up a bit. Started by softening some onion, carrots and celery in butter. Then added the broth and seasonings. Let that come to a boil. Then I added wide egg noodles instead of the frozen, reduced the heat and let them soften and soak up the broth. While that was working I browned the chicken breasts in olive oil, seasoning them with a little salt, pepper and garlic powder. Once the noodles had soaked up most of the broth I added the creamed soups. And finally added the browned chicken breasts cut up bite sized. Stirred it all up and let it simmer for another 10 minutes.
I cooked in crockpot on low for six hours starting with frozen chicken breasts and throwing everything else except the noodles in. I only did one can of chicken broth

I used about 2 pounds chicken thighs, boiled (simmered) with salt, pepper, 1 cut up onion, 3 carrots cut in 2 in pieces, 2 stalks celery cut up in 2-3 in pieces, and a bay leaf. When chicken was tender, took chicken off bone and used this chicken in the recipe with the soups, used 1 can chicken broth and remainder broth was home made stock I had in freezer, and added a can of mushrooms and cut up the carrot, onion and celery used in cooking chicken into the chicken and noodles. I put the bones from chicken back in broth and simmered a little longer and then had broth to freeze, as well. I used the seasoning in chicken and noodle recipe as cited, added some ground pepper and parsley. Turned out delicious.

My family loved this. I made a couple of changes only because I had looked at the recipe wrong and did not by the large can of cream of chicken soup. I used 2-10 oz cans cream of chicken, 1 can cream of mushroom, then only 2 cans of chicken broth to keep the ratio about the same. Also, I used one 16 oz. bag of frozen Reames egg noodles. I only used a sprinkling of the seasonings and no salt. (cream soups are salty enough for me). I cooked the egg noodles separately then heated up the other ingredients and combined them. It was great.

I had to improvise a lot because i only had 1 can cream of chicken so here’s my revision 1 32 oz box and 1 can chicken broth, 1 can cream of chick soup, 16 oz. of heavy whipping cream, 2 cups canned chicken, 1-24 oz bag of frozen egg noodles. Same amount of spices. I added a jar a mushrooms. It was fantastic! Next time I’ll add veggies like carrots and peas and onion. As a basic recipe is a as wonderful! Everyone loved it!!

Such a great recipe! I wanted to have some veggies in mine tho so I saute together several carrots and celery stalks, diced, with diced onion. I didnt have seasoned salt so I added salt, pepper, celery seed and paprika and a teaspoon of Knorr chicken boullion to improvise. I could only find the noodles in 24 oz bags so I went with that and added a little more chicken broth. Whether I made changes or not this recipe is very good, if you want to add some veggies to it or personalize it more the recipe as a base is easy to work with.

I love this recipe it's the same one my mom uses the only thing I do differently is use cream of chicken only also I cook mine in the crockpot so I can just set it and forget it but this recipe is definitely the way to go, it's comes out delicious every time

Otto really liked this. Used 1 1/2 cups broth and one can cream of chicken soup, cut up cooked chicken . Cooked noodles separately and added at the end. Used poultry seasoning and sage. Garlic, onion powder and pepper. 
Next time I’ll add celery, carrots and maybe peas.
This was a great simple recipe. I followed everything except I used regular noodles instead of frozen. It turned out just fine. I'll be using this for camping in our motorhome too!

Great recipe! I used 5 quarts of Better Than Boullion Roasted Chicken Flavor Broth, 2 cups of shredded/diced rotisserie chicken from the local supermarket. We substituted 2 cups of Creamettes Large Rings instead of Wavy Egg Noodles. My kids ate the whole pot in a day and requested it as a weekly meal! Hard to get a 9 & 11 yr old to both agree to something, but this recipe did it. It was the perfect casserole consistency, which is what we were going for.
Mmmmmm
added cup of parmesan cheese. next time will use thinner noodles, after 25 minutes noodles were still firmer than I liked. But omg the flavors were awesome.
Was really good and took some to my neighbor. Will try again soon. Maybe an extra can of cream of chicken.

I used regular egg noodles and 1 can cream of chicken and 1 can cream of celery. My family does not like mushrooms. Once I add the egg noodles I turned it down to a low simmer stirred to make sure didn't stick. And cooked till noodles were down. I will definitely make again.
Added celery and shredded carrots! Couldn’t get much easier. I also used only cr of chicken…I hate cr of mushroom. Made some Rhodes Rolls go accompany! Very comforting and tasty meal!!
So I boiled Spaghetti noodles separately then added. For the sauce, I added half a block of Velveeta & also added broccoli. Everyone was begging for more!

When you’re sick and need something easy and quick. This is perfect. I used rotisserie chicken I shredded, and no yolks ( that’s what I had) put everything in pot flame on low and 20 minutes later it was done.
